# Portal reference

These pages reproduce the EcoCash Developer Portal's own material **as published**, including its inconsistencies. For the clear, corrected walkthrough, start with the [guide](../). Where the two differ, see [Known portal issues](../known-issues/).

- [Documentation tab (verbatim)](documentation-tab/) - The EcoCash developer portal's EIP Documentation tab reproduced verbatim: overview, API reference, error codes, test data, SMS and test script.
- [SDKs & Codegen tab (verbatim)](sdks-tab/) - All 15 EcoCash EIP SDK samples from the portal verbatim: Java, PHP/Laravel, JavaScript, C# and Python, with review notes on their defects.
- [Portal walkthrough](portal-getting-started/) - Screenshot walkthrough of the EcoCash Developer Portal: sign in, request sandbox access, inbox credentials, Authorization header and test number verification.
